description: A React component implementing the client-side UI for document ingestion in a Next.js application, allowing users to upload files for various categories, connect LinkedIn, and trigger persona generation workflows.

methods.name: formatBytes
methods.description: Formats a number of bytes into a human-readable string with units (B, KB, MB, GB).

methods.name: getFileExtLabel
methods.description: Returns the file extension label in uppercase or 'FILE' if no extension.

methods.name: makeId
methods.description: Generates a random 12-character string used as unique IDs.

methods.name: categoryLabel
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly label for a given upload category.

methods.name: categoryTitle
methods.description: Returns a descriptive title for each upload category.

methods.name: categoryAccent
methods.description: Returns color codes associated with each upload category.

methods.name: acceptString
methods.description: Returns accepted file types for uploading (.pdf, .docx, .txt).
